treatment.name: same-session-target-state-complete-program-replay
treatment.causal_estimand_note: The treatment bundles same-session replay feedback with an additional executable attempt. This census estimates the replay-enabled procedure, not the isolated causal effect of feedback content.

retry_attempts.termination: Python package index failed to return setuptools candidates before the executable goal ran.
The candidate bootstrap completed, but the evaluator's post-bootstrap Pyright installation timed out at files.pythonhosted.org.
The Python package index failed to return h5py candidates before the executable goal ran.
The stim source archive download timed out at files.pythonhosted.org before the executable goal ran.

mechanism_observation.b_package_layout_repair: After installing the real TensorFlow distribution, B copied its non-empty _api/v2/experimental subtree to the distribution's public experimental package path inside the virtual environment.
mechanism_observation.boundary_interpretation: The package-layout repair did not modify the repository or evaluator and did not create an empty or fake module, so it is admissible under the frozen open-operation boundary-v6. It remains a distinct compatibility-repair category for later sensitivity analysis rather than a generic dependency-install result.
mechanism_observation.interpretation: B demonstrated an operational same-session clean replay and submitted the identical certified program, which passed Official. A1 failed Official. Because every unchanged A2 Official attempt was infrastructure-censored, this case supports B terminal efficacy but cannot establish a B advantage over an independent free-Agent resample.

infrastructure_censoring.detail: The first source acquisition failed; an unchanged fresh retry completed and produced the valid A1 Official failure.
A pretty-printed multi-line JSON object was mistakenly supplied to the JSONL input before candidate execution. The input was corrected to a single unchanged JSONL record.
Four exact-program retries ended in external package-index or evaluator dependency-download failures. No retry produced a valid terminal Official outcome.
The advisory fresh replay reported 326 active findings and returned no feedback to the Agent. It is not substituted for the missing Official outcome.

cumulative_interpretation.promotion_rule: Promotion requires terminal Official success gains over valid free-Agent outcomes on the fixed census; frontier improvement alone is insufficient.
not_established: B advantage over an independent free-Agent resample on position 14
causal effect of replay feedback content separated from added execution opportunity

safeguard_effect: No new hash, frozen contract, or runtime gate was added.
